message:
fix(ledger): share bounded Git-ignore policy and owner-aware reconciliation

Use the vetted ignore matcher for nested globs and negation, without ambient
global policy. Refuse incomplete walks rather than treating unseen sources as
deleted. Separate exclusions from tombstones and preserve imported snapshots.
Introduce inherited cancellation, deadline and byte/item budgets for daemon use.
